certificate.input_law: on every sufficiently old supplied epoch, the existing positive NN-intersect-critical heat sublaw has mass at least (1/4)e^(-1/32)=0.242308308619 of S_heat
certificate.selection: normalize that physical heat sublaw itself; no shell argmax, coherent-cell maximizer or uniform atom mass is introduced
certificate.scale: for A=3M/4, the hard shell {M/2<|xi|<=M} becomes {2A/3<|xi|<=4A/3}
certificate.smooth_envelope: choose scalar Q_A=1 on the hard shell with support lower >=3A/5 and upper <=3A/2; the hard shell [0.666666666667,1.33333333333]A lies strictly inside this plateau envelope
certificate.dual_probe: with psi=P_j u/||P_j u||, <Q_A u,psi>=||P_j u|| exactly; the smooth carrier seed inherits the whole-shell critical coefficient without choosing a packet
certificate.low_low: if the renewed A-scale strain action stays <=1/30, the envelope lower edge remains (3/5)e^(-1/30)A>A/2; dimensionless gap=0.0803296602892
certificate.material_provenance: each seed retains the NN coherent heat-edge mark that selected its shell-time atom, but the theorem does not claim the whole u-shell is new material; V-shell heat provenance and u-shell critical energy remain distinct exact marks
certificate.scope: this supplies a positive law of lower-scale smooth Fourier carrier seeds with critical coefficients and support moat; it does not yet extend a seed through a full A-natural slab, identify its whole energy as NN material, or prove universal slab renewal
